scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.pack:exe: npm --prefix client run build && electron-builder --win portable
scripts.pack:installer: npm --prefix client run build && electron-builder --win nsis
scripts.cap:sync: npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix client run cap:sync
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
